description: This file provides utility functions for calculating costs associated with OpenAI models, including token-based costs, time-based costs, and video generation costs. It includes functions for routing cost calculation based on call types and for retrieving cost parameters dynamically based on model information.

methods.name: Literal["cost_per_token","cost_per_second"] cost_router(call_type: CallTypes)
methods.description: Determines whether to calculate cost per token or per second based on call type.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] cost_per_token( model: str, usage: Usage, service_tier: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Calculates the cost in USD for tokens used in a given model and usage scenario.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] cost_per_second( model: str, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str], duration: float = 0.0 )
methods.description: Calculates the per-second cost in USD for a model based on its pricing info and response duration.

methods.name: float video_generation_cost( model: str, duration_seconds: float, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Calculates the total cost in USD for video generation given model info and duration.
